d:
In this video, we decode the business strategies of Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel, their ARPU gap, premiumisation strategy, prepaid and postpaid plans, Jio's IPO, and the possibility of another telecom tariff hike. We also look at how Vodafone Idea and TRAI could influence the future of India's telecom industry.
Will Jio increase tariffs after its IPO? Can Airtel sustain its premium pricing strategy? And ultimately, who will pay the price of this telecom battle? You and me, the customers?
